label: Scene Template: Speaker Screencast (camera PiP)
description: WHOLE-SCENE template for THE most common speaker pattern: a full-frame screen recording (product walkthrough / demo) with the film's speaker riding along as a small circular camera bubble in the corner. Instantiation is deterministic (NO codegen, NO critique) -- give it the footage URL as 'source' and it stamps out the known-good composite: an OPAQUE scene over a brand-gradient background, the recording in a frameless rounded card inset ~20px (corner_radius masks the black corners a rounded-window recording bakes into its source), and the camera PiP wired to the project speaker track. Use whenever the film has a speaker_track AND a screen recording to show. For the SPEAKER-VISIBLE modes (speaker beside content, or lower-third) keep the scene transparent and lay content in the content_region instead.

pip_source.label: Camera PiP source. DEFAULT 'speaker' -- binds the bubble to the project speaker track and auto-syncs it (one camera reference, no drift). Pass a plain camera video URL only for a non-speaker-track camera. Set to 'none' to hide the bubble.

theme.label: dark (default -- brand-gradient world) | light (soft lavender world)

backdrop_image.label: Optional brand background image URL -- replaces the gradient (slow Ken Burns + scrim).

corner_radius.label: Footage card corner radius px (default 30 -- masks the black corners of a rounded-window recording).

max_width_pct.label: Footage card width % (default 88 -- insets ~20px top/bottom so it floats).

pip_position.label: PiP corner: bottom-right (default) | bottom-left | top-right | top-left

pip_size.label: PiP width as % of the frame (default 15 -- a tasteful bubble; 22+ dominates).

pip_start_at.label: Seconds into the camera clip where this scene's PiP starts (speaker-track mode sets it automatically).

kicker.label: Optional small-caps line at the top (opt-in via show_kicker).

show_kicker.label: Show the top kicker (default false -- the footage is the star).

captions.label: Array of {at, text}: narration-timed lower-third beats. Hidden unless captions_style is 'beats'.
